title: ellisia torreyi var. paniculata
intro: Ellisia torreyi var. paniculata, commonly known as Panicled Ellisia or Ellisia paniculata, is a type of flowering plant that belongs to the Lamiaceae family. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, acting as an antioxidant, and exhibiting antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Ellisia torreyi var. paniculata include its ability to inhibit the growth of bacteria and fungi, making it a potential natural remedy for wound healing and skin infections. The bioactive constituents responsible for these effects include phenolic acids, flavonoids, and terpenoids, which have been identified in various studies on the plant's chemical composition.
